ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda — Chrome credential harvest via PowerShell pre-encryption (Sophos X-Ops tradecraft)
ucs.description: Hunts the distinctive Qilin RaaS behaviour documented by Sophos X-Ops in 2024: a PowerShell stage (often pushed as a GPO logon script — IPScanner.ps1 / Logger.ps1 staged in SYSVOL) reads Chrome's 'Login Data' SQLite database from every logged-on user's profile before the encryptor is deployed. This pre-encryption credential theft step is unusual among ransomware crews and is the single most actor-defining Qilin behaviour on Windows estates.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_proc values(Processes.parent_process) as parent_cmd from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name="powershell.exe" OR Processes.process_name="pwsh.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Login Data*" OR Processes.process="*Google\\Chrome\\User Data*" OR Processes.process="*ChromePass*" OR Processes.process="*WebBrowserPassView*" OR Processes.process="*IPScanner*" OR Processes.process="*Logger.ps1*") by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name host 
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` 
| search NOT user="*$" 
| eval qilin_indicators=mvappend(if(match(cmdline,"(?i)Login Data"),"chrome_logindata",null()), if(match(cmdline,"(?i)IPScanner|Logger\.ps1"),"qilin_script_name",null()), if(match(parent_proc,"(?i)gpscript\.exe"),"gpo_logon_script",null())) 
| where mvcount(qilin_indicators)>=1 
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) 
| table firstTime lastTime host user process_name parent_proc parent_cmd cmdline qilin_indicators count
ucs.kql:
// Qilin Chrome credential harvest — process-side
let PsChromeAccess = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Login Data", @"Google\Chrome\User Data", "ChromePass", "WebBrowserPassView", "IPScanner", "Logger.ps1")
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"
    | extend QilinHints = pack_array(
        iff(ProcessCommandLine has "Login Data", "chrome_logindata", ""),
        iff(ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)IPScanner|Logger\.ps1", "qilin_script_name", ""),
        iff(InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "gpscript.exe", "gpo_logon_script", ""),
        iff(ProcessCommandLine has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\NETLOGON\"), "sysvol_staging", ""))
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
              ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ChildImage  = FolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
              SHA256, QilinHints;
// File-side corroboration: actual touch of Login Data by a script host
let FileTouch = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where FileName =~ "Login Data"
    | where FolderPath has @"\Google\Chrome\User Data\"
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","cscript.exe","wscript.exe","gpscript.exe","robocopy.exe","xcopy.exe")
    | where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName,
              AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              ChildImage  = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
              ChildCmd    = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              ActionType, TouchedFile = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName);
union PsChromeAccess, FileTouch
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin Chrome credential harvest — Sentinel via SecurityEvent 4688
let Look = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(Look)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\powershell.exe" or NewProcessName endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has_any ("Login Data", @"Google\Chrome\User Data", "ChromePass", "WebBrowserPassView", "IPScanner", "Logger.ps1")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" and TargetUserName !endswith "$"
| extend QilinHints = pack_array(
    iff(CommandLine has "Login Data", "chrome_logindata", ""),
    iff(CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)IPScanner|Logger\.ps1", "qilin_script_name", ""),
    iff(ParentProcessName endswith "\\gpscript.exe", "gpo_logon_script", ""),
    iff(CommandLine has_any (@"\SYSVOL\", @"\NETLOGON\"), "sysvol_staging", ""))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName, TargetUserName,
          ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, QilinHints
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Qilin/Agenda - Chrome Credential Harvest via PowerShell (Pre-Encryption)
id: 9f3b1c2d-7e84-4a91-bd2f-3c1a55e4b9c1
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the Qilin (Agenda) RaaS pre-encryption credential theft
  pattern documented by Sophos X-Ops, where a PowerShell stage
  (often pushed via GPO logon script as IPScanner.ps1 or Logger.ps1)
  reads Chrome Login Data SQLite databases from logged-on user
  profiles before deploying the encryptor.
references:
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2024/08/22/qilin-ransomware-caught-stealing-credentials-stored-in-google-chrome/
author: detection-engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1555.003
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1037.001
  - threat.actor.qilin
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'Login Data'
      - 'Google\Chrome\User Data'
      - 'ChromePass'
      - 'WebBrowserPassView'
      - 'IPScanner'
      - 'Logger.ps1'
  filter_machine:
    User|endswith: '$'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and not filter_machine
falsepositives:
  - Authorised IT scripts that audit stored browser credentials
  - Endpoint forensic tooling collecting Chrome artefacts
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\PWSH.EXE) (@CommandLine:*"Login Data"* OR @CommandLine:*"Google\Chrome\User Data"* OR @CommandLine:*"google\chrome\user data"* OR @CommandLine:*ChromePass* OR @CommandLine:*chromepass* OR @CommandLine:*IPScanner* OR @CommandLine:*ipscanner* OR @CommandLine:*Logger.ps1* OR @CommandLine:*logger.ps1*) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| regex("(Login Data|Google\\\\Chrome\\\\User Data|ChromePass|WebBrowserPassView|IPScanner|Logger\\.ps1)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| ParentBaseName := ParentBaseFileName
| QilinHint := if(regex("Login Data", field=CommandLine, strict=false), then="chrome_logindata", else=if(regex("(IPScanner|Logger\\.ps1)", field=CommandLine, strict=false), then="qilin_script_name", else=if(ParentBaseFileName=/gpscript\.exe/i, then="gpo_logon_script", else="other")))
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, QilinHint], function=[count(), min(@timestamp, as=firstSeen), max(@timestamp, as=lastSeen)])
| sort(lastSeen, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Sophos X-Ops attributed this specific PowerShell-via-GPO Chrome credential-dump pattern to a Qilin affiliate in August 2024 — it is not a behaviour seen across the RaaS landscape and is far rarer than the usual LSASS-dump path. Combining (a) powershell.exe with the Chrome Login Data path, (b) the Qilin-named scripts IPScanner.ps1 / Logger.ps1, (c) a gpscript.exe parent (GPO logon-script execution)

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda — pre-encryption recovery sabotage + EDR/backup kill chain on a single host
ucs.description: Hunts the tight time-window cluster that Qilin (Agenda) reliably executes immediately before its Rust/Go encryptor fires: rapid vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit recovery destruction co-located with net stop / sc stop / taskkill against Veeam, Sophos, Defender, SQL and Acronis services on the same host, often under SYSTEM via PsExec lateral movement. The cluster — and the Qilin encryptor's distinctive `-p <password>` / `--no-vm-kill` / `--yes` CLI flags — separates this from one-off admin maintenance.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name IN ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")) AND (Processes.process="*delete shadows*" OR Processes.process="*delete catalog*" OR Processes.process="*recoveryenabled No*" OR Processes.process="*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*shadowcopy delete*" OR Processes.process="*Veeam*" OR Processes.process="*Sophos*" OR Processes.process="*WinDefend*" OR Processes.process="*MsMpSvc*" OR Processes.process="*MSSQL*" OR Processes.process="*BackupExec*" OR Processes.process="*Acronis*" OR Processes.process="--no-vm-kill" OR Processes.process="* -p *" AND Processes.process="*--yes*") by Processes.dest Processes.user host _time span=5m
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| eval qilin_buckets=mvappend(if(match(mvjoin(cmds," "),"(?i)delete shadows|delete catalog|recoveryenabled No|shadowcopy delete"),"recovery_sabotage",null()), if(match(mvjoin(cmds," "),"(?i)Veeam|Sophos|WinDefend|MsMpSvc|MSSQL|BackupExec|Acronis"),"sec_backup_kill",null()), if(match(mvjoin(cmds," "),"--no-vm-kill|--yes"),"qilin_encryptor_flags",null()), if(match(mvjoin(parents," "),"(?i)psexesvc\.exe|PSEXESVC"),"psexec_remote",null()))
| where mvcount(qilin_buckets)>=2
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| table firstTime lastTime host user procs cmds parents qilin_buckets count
ucs.kql:
// Qilin pre-encryption sabotage cluster — bucket by host+5m
let Look = 7d;
let Bucket = 5m;
let Evt = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(Look)
    | where FileName in~ ("vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","wmic.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","sc.exe","taskkill.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
    | extend RecoverySabotage = Cmd has_any ("delete shadows", "delete catalog", "recoveryenabled no", "bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures", "shadowcopy delete")
    | extend SecBackupKill   = Cmd has_any ("veeam","sophos","windefend","msmpsvc","mssql","backupexec","acronis","sense","sentinelone","crowdstrike")
    | extend EncryptorFlags  = Cmd has_any ("--no-vm-kill","--yes") or (Cmd matches regex @"\s-p\s+[a-z0-9!@#\$%\^&\*]{8,}\b" and Cmd has_any (".exe ",".bin "))
    | extend PsExecParent    = InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "psexesvc.exe"
    | where RecoverySabotage or SecBackupKill or EncryptorFlags
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, RecoverySabotage, SecBackupKill, EncryptorFlags, PsExecParent;
Evt
| summarize BucketStart = bin(min(Timestamp), Bucket),
            LastEvt     = max(Timestamp),
            EvtCount    = count(),
            RecoveryHits = countif(RecoverySabotage),
            KillHits     = countif(SecBackupKill),
            EncryptHits  = countif(EncryptorFlags),
            PsExecSeen   = countif(PsExecParent),
            SampleCmds   = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            Bins         = make_set(FileName, 10)
            by DeviceName, AccountName, bin(Timestamp, Bucket)
| extend ClusterScore = iff(RecoveryHits>0,1,0) + iff(KillHits>0,1,0) + iff(EncryptHits>0,1,0) + iff(PsExecSeen>0,1,0)
| where ClusterScore >= 2
| where AccountName !endswith "$" or PsExecSeen > 0
| order by LastEvt desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Qilin pre-encryption sabotage cluster — Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688
let Look = 7d;
let Bucket = 5m;
let Evt = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Look)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ProcLower = tolower(NewProcessName)
    | where ProcLower endswith "\\vssadmin.exe" or ProcLower endswith "\\wbadmin.exe"
         or ProcLower endswith "\\bcdedit.exe" or ProcLower endswith "\\wmic.exe"
         or ProcLower endswith "\\net.exe"     or ProcLower endswith "\\net1.exe"
         or ProcLower endswith "\\sc.exe"      or ProcLower endswith "\\taskkill.exe"
         or ProcLower endswith "\\powershell.exe" or ProcLower endswith "\\pwsh.exe"
    | extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
    | extend RecoverySabotage = Cmd has_any ("delete shadows","delete catalog","recoveryenabled no","bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures","shadowcopy delete")
    | extend SecBackupKill   = Cmd has_any ("veeam","sophos","windefend","msmpsvc","mssql","backupexec","acronis","sense","sentinelone","crowdstrike")
    | extend EncryptorFlags  = Cmd has_any ("--no-vm-kill","--yes") or (Cmd matches regex @"\s-p\s+[a-z0-9!@#\$%\^&\*]{8,}\b" and Cmd has_any (".exe ",".bin "))
    | extend PsExecParent    = tolower(ParentProcessName) endswith "\\psexesvc.exe"
    | where RecoverySabotage or SecBackupKill or EncryptorFlags
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName,
              RecoverySabotage, SecBackupKill, EncryptorFlags, PsExecParent;
Evt
| summarize BucketStart   = bin(min(TimeGenerated), Bucket),
            LastEvt       = max(TimeGenerated),
            EvtCount      = count(),
            RecoveryHits  = countif(RecoverySabotage),
            KillHits      = countif(SecBackupKill),
            EncryptHits   = countif(EncryptorFlags),
            PsExecSeen    = countif(PsExecParent),
            SampleCmds    = make_set(CommandLine, 10)
            by Computer, SubjectUserName, bin(TimeGenerated, Bucket)
| extend ClusterScore = iff(RecoveryHits>0,1,0) + iff(KillHits>0,1,0) + iff(EncryptHits>0,1,0) + iff(PsExecSeen>0,1,0)
| where ClusterScore >= 2
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$" or PsExecSeen > 0
| order by LastEvt desc
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBAdmin.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\BCDEDIT.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\Net.exe OR *\net1.exe OR *\sc.exe OR *\SC.exe OR *\taskkill.exe OR *\Taskkill.exe OR *\TASKKILL.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE)) AND (@CommandLine:*"delete shadows"* OR @CommandLine:*"Delete Shadows"* OR @CommandLine:*"DELETE SHADOWS"* OR @CommandLine:*"delete catalog"* OR @CommandLine:*"Delete Catalog"* OR @CommandLine:*"recoveryenabled No"* OR @CommandLine:*"recoveryenabled no"* OR @CommandLine:*"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR @CommandLine:*"shadowcopy delete"* OR @CommandLine:*Veeam* OR @CommandLine:*veeam* OR @CommandLine:*VEEAM* OR @CommandLine:*Sophos* OR @CommandLine:*sophos* OR @CommandLine:*WinDefend* OR @CommandLine:*windefend* OR @CommandLine:*MsMpSvc* OR @CommandLine:*msmpsvc* OR @CommandLine:*BackupExec* OR @CommandLine:*backupexec* OR @CommandLine:*Acronis* OR @CommandLine:*acronis* OR @CommandLine:*--no-vm-kill* OR @CommandLine:*--yes*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(vssadmin|wbadmin|bcdedit|wmic|net1?|sc|taskkill|powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| CmdLower := lower(CommandLine)
| RecoverySabotage := if(regex("delete shadows|delete catalog|recoveryenabled no|bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures|shadowcopy delete", field=CmdLower, strict=false), then=1, else=0)
| SecBackupKill   := if(regex("veeam|sophos|windefend|msmpsvc|mssql|backupexec|acronis|sense|sentinelone|crowdstrike", field=CmdLower, strict=false), then=1, else=0)
| EncryptorFlags  := if(regex("--no-vm-kill|--yes", field=CmdLower, strict=false), then=1, else=0)
| PsExecParent    := if(ParentBaseFileName=/psexesvc\.exe/i, then=1, else=0)
| RecoverySabotage > 0 OR SecBackupKill > 0 OR EncryptorFlags > 0
| bucket(span=5m, function=[count(as=EvtCount), sum(RecoverySabotage, as=RecoveryHits), sum(SecBackupKill, as=KillHits), sum(EncryptorFlags, as=EncryptHits), sum(PsExecParent, as=PsExecSeen), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, UserName])], field=[aid, ComputerName])
| ClusterScore := if(RecoveryHits>0,then=1,else=0) + if(KillHits>0,then=1,else=0) + if(EncryptHits>0,then=1,else=0) + if(PsExecSeen>0,then=1,else=0)
| ClusterScore >= 2
| sort(_bucket, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: Individually, vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit, service stops, and a -p flagged binary execution are all generic. Qilin's signature is the *co-location*: Trend Micro, Halcyon, and Group-IB Agenda reporting all describe the encryptor (Rust/Go) running with bespoke `--no-vm-kill`, `--yes`, and `-p <password>` flags within seconds of the recovery-destruction commands, frequently triggered remotely via PsExec
